spans.s:
Kahoḍa Kauṣītaki or Kauṣītakeya is mentioned in the Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, the Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad, and the śāṅkhāyana Āraṇyaka, as a teacher, contemporary with yājñavalkya. Cf. kāhoḍi.
Foot notes Satapatha brāhmaṇa, ii. 4, 3, 1; Sāṅkhāyana Āraṇyaka, xv.
Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad, iii. 5, 1.

Kāhoḍi (‘descendant of Kahoḍa’) is the patronymic of argala in the kāṭhaka Saṃhitā (xxv. 5).
